# heraut commit check

Validate every commit in a range (or full history) against the conventional-commit grammar.

Check every commit in a range (git's own range syntax), every commit since the latest tag, or the
whole history. Invalid commits are listed with the reason and the exit code is 1 when there is any.
Merge and fixup commits are skipped. Run it in CI on a pull request's commits.

## Usage

```text
heraut commit check [rev-range] [flags]
```

## Examples

```bash
heraut commit check
heraut commit check origin/main..HEAD
heraut commit check --from-latest-tag
```

## Flags

| Flag | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--env <string>` |  | target environment (for per-env strategies) |
| `--from-latest-tag` |  | check commits since the latest tag (mutually exclusive with rev-range) |

## Global flags

| Flag | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--config <string>` |  | path to .heraut.yml (default: auto-discover) |
| `--verbose` |  | echo each command and emit diagnostic logs |
